Select distinct compound ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for molecules with activity records linked to assays where assay_organism is 'Homo sapiens' and the assay target is CHEMBL203. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
